text:
maya-partner: Hey all — Spectra confirmed NDA and asked for an onboarding runbook + sanitized perf snapshot for SI partners. Can we outline deliverables?

rory-eng: Quick scope: verified image, KV snapshot, bench script, sanitized JSONL perf dump, and short runbook.

priya-legal: Important: no request/response payloads in artifacts. Perf dumps must be numeric-only and anonymized; retention 30 days. I'll attach the redline.

lee-infra: We can produce a pre-seeded KV snapshot (max 4GB) and a dedicated subnet. Need partner account IDs for private marketplace access.

dana-pp: For the partner runbook I'll include steps: deploy image, import KV snapshot, run bench, collect results.jsonl, and troubleshoot section. Will need exact CLI commands.

rory-eng: CLI example: 

```
# reproducible bench
rbench --image rwd/spectra-preview:2024-05 --model llama-2-13b --seq 512 --concurrency 16 --duration 300 --out results.jsonl
```

results.jsonl should contain only: seq_len,tokens_per_sec,median_ms,p95_ms,build_id.

maya-partner: Spectra will provide firmware power traces (aggregated) and a mapping for driver versions. They prefer JSONL format for traces.

priya-legal: Approve aggregated power traces if they contain no device serials or request identifiers. Add embargo clause for co-marketing.

lee-infra: Action items: create AMI + image repo, pre-seed KV snapshot, private marketplace entry, and generate an allowlist for partner accounts. ETA 5 business days after legal signoff.

dana-pp: I'll draft the runbook and a 3-slide SI training deck. Want the bench numbers ASAP (even provisional) so copy isn't misleading.

rory-eng: Provisional lab numbers (internal only): median 120ms @ seq512/concurrency16 on Spectra X1 with our runtime. We'll phrase as "internal preview tests".

maya-partner: Spectra ok with provisional numbers under embargo. They'll send the partner reviewer list and embargo calendar by EOD tomorrow.

infra-bot: <ticket-PRT-9021> created: SPECTRA-SNAPSHOT-ONBOARD - AMI + KV snapshot + private tile (assignee: lee-infra).

priya-legal: Owners: Priya = legal redline + embargo, Lee = infra + private tile, Rory = bench harness + sanitized artifact, Dana = runbook + SI deck, Maya = Spectra liaison.

maya-partner: Thanks everyone. Let's keep updates here — will confirm partner list and artifacts timeline shortly.

rory-eng: I'll push the initial AMI and bench harness to the partner repo and ping when results.jsonl is available.

dana-pp: Scheduling a 30-min SI sync next Wed — sending invite.

maya-partner: Sounds good. :thumbsup:
